notes: Fish Audio mirrors upstream 3.0.46: `FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY`, bearer auth, custom base URL and headers, versioned user-agent suffix, binary `/v1/tts` speech generation with model headers, output formats, latency/normalization/sampling controls and warnings, plus multipart `/v1/asr` transcription with language, duration, and timed text segments. Request/response metadata, abort propagation, and Fish `{status,message}` error handling follow the published package.
